title: Why Ice Floats
hook: Almost everything sinks when it freezes, but ice floats.
script: Almost everything sinks when it freezes, but ice floats. Water is one of the only things that expands when it freezes. That makes ice less dense than the water it came from. So what happens to a bottle of water in your freezer? It bursts, because the ice has nowhere to go. And how does ice break solid rock? Water seeps into a crack, freezes, and pushes it apart. Every winter, that splits boulders and tears up roads. Without this quirk, lakes would freeze from the bottom up, and fish would have nowhere to go.
